notes.title: TMR 3.6: New classes 'Champion' and 'Beetle', and a lot of polishing
notes.content:
The next round of adding more content and polishing the game.
My hearty thanks to player Colten for his effort in tracking down grammar issues and suggesting corrections / alternatives. Very much appreciated!

Features:
---------------------------
- New class Champion added which is basically a sword wielding retaliation specialist. Available for both player and enemy faction.
- New monster class Beetle added as opponent to several scenarios.
- New scenario 4a added where a Champion joins the player's team.
- Alternate floor tile color for dungeons added to have more change.
- A few minor UI overhauls like color changes and image size changes.


Scenario Balancing:
---------------------------
- Scenario 9 (Highwayman): Difficulty slightly decreased.
- Scenario 102 (Burglary): Positioning and timing of guards overhauled, so it's possible now to take them out 1 by 1.
- Scenario 110 (Below Willowdale): Difficulty slightly decreased.
- Scenario 1b (TheSewers): Fiasko is not prohibited any longer from joining the battle in this scene.
- Scenario 10 (Mage Tower): Overhauled to make it more interesting.


Class Balancing:
---------------------------
- To make bandits more flexible early on, they have the skill Withdraw now. The new main damage skill is a beefed up Rend Armor instead of Double Strike.
- Overhauled skill Hit and Run: Substantially strengthened the skill and made it available earlier on for Bandit Archers. The main purpose of this skill is to support guerilla tactics close to an owned outpost.
- The bandit's chance of stealing successfully is not always 100% any longer but depends on the skill rank: 60% for Rank 0 and 10 % additional chance for each rank. Thus, a fully maxed Purse Strike / Purse Shot skill grants a 90% chance of stealing successfully.
- Overhauled skill Ram. Causes always physical damage now and more damage per rank. This change makes the skill much more useful for the Travel Mage for instance.
- Overhauled skill Beast Shot to make it stronger against beasts but weaker against non-beasts.
- Overhauled skill Riposte because it had granted more Pow than intended. The Ret buff remains basically the same, but the Pow buff has a fixed amount now for all ranks.
- Commoner damage and healing slightly increased.
- Ranger has slightly more MP now.
- Changed a few recommendation notes at the character selection screen. Warden is now marked as 'recommended for beginners', for example.


Bug Fixes:
---------------------------
- A few graphical glitches of the dungeon tile set and the interior tile set fixed.
- Occasionally missing unit shadows during post-battle dialogues fixed.
- Occasionally wrong rotation of riders' forelegs fixed.
- Several English grammar issues fixed (kudos to player Colter for his effort in tracking them down and suggesting corrections).
- Changed Ally Camp lighting in the Cave to avoid color gradient banding.

notes.title: TMR version 3.5 released
notes.content:
Tactics Maiden Remastered Version 3.5 released.
Kudos to player Snuggy Serian for tracking and reporting the bugs in detail below. Very much appreciated!

Features:
-----------------------------
- Two new classes 'Mage Knight' and 'Shadow Spear'
- Added repeatable scenario 204 that is available already after scene 4. Unlike later repeatable scenarios, this scenario is limited to enemies of level 2 only, though.
- A more challenging alternate variation added for scenarios 3, 4, 102, 103, 104, 104b
- New button 'Delete All Game Saves Below' that can be used to delete more than one game save at once
- Now 300 local game save slots instead of 100
- Improved ally camp atmosphere: Grass patches, more flowers and foot prints added to ally camp. Color scheme slightly changed
- Color of text messages darkened and overhauled scrollbar graphics

Balancing:
-----------------------------
- Skill Paladin's Holy Smite is more powerful now: universal damage against undead already available at rank 2. At rank 3 the attack range is increased by 1
- Skill Charge: Rank 0 atk reduced from 95% to 90%

Bugfixes:
-----------------------------
- Fixed a few glitches when performing several actions in a row very quickly, e.g. Fire Golem's Explode skill not killing the Golem as intended.
- Fixed exploit where skill 'Replace' could teleport a unit to any spot on the map
- The skill 'Send Home' cannot be used on the Queen any longer. This was done in order to avoid exploits in mission 19 and 21 where the Queen has to be protected.
- Fixed a bug where ability Stealth Hunter enabled attacking hidden units
- Fixed an issue where a wrong hair style was shown on some portraits after starting a scenario
